I am 65, never spent a day in school. My father taught me everything, and I have worked this land in Quzhou for 40 years. Now it is just me and my wife at home. Twenty mu is too much for two old people, so I pay the tractor driver to come rotary-till and plough, and I hire young workers for harvest time. I do not try new things unless I saw them work on my neighbor's field first.

Last year my wheat did well — about 1000 jin per mu. I always plant improved wheat seed, the kind everyone buys from the seed shop. Last autumn I had the tractor rotary-till the 16 mu and I spread one bag of compound fertilizer on every mu before sowing. This spring, when the wheat turns green, I will spread half a bag of urea on each mu, and when it starts jointing I will spread another half bag. A 50-jin bag of compound fertilizer and two 20-jin half-bags of urea per mu — that is what I have done for years. Fertilizer costs real money, but if the wheat is thin you lose everything. Better to waste a little fertilizer than cry over empty grain bags. I will water it three times from the well: once when it greens up, once when it shoots up tall, and once when the grain is filling. I spray herbicide once in early spring, and if the aphids come I spray again. I expect 1000 jin per mu again if the weather holds.

After we cut the wheat in June, I plant hybrid maize seed on those same 16 mu. The machine drills it straight into the rotary-tilled ground. I put one bag of compound fertilizer and one bag of urea on each mu for the corn, just like last year. Maize does not need as much water as wheat — I irrigate twice from the well if the rain does not come. One spray for weeds at sowing, and one more if the corn borers show up. I hope for 1200 jin per mu.

I keep 4 mu of cotton. It is heavy work with only two of us, but the cotton money helps pay for the hired labor. In spring I have the tractor deep-plough that piece. Cotton is greedy — I give it one and a half bags of compound fertilizer per mu, and half a bag of urea. I water it three times and spray bugs four times. If the price is like last year, I hope for 500 jin of seed cotton per mu. I use improved cotton seed.

I do not know the names on the bags. I just tell the dealer: "Give me what everyone else is buying." That is how I decide.
